glossEn: that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord
note: that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher centers。线索：the human brain / brain damage。

glossEn: the brain of certain animals used as meat
note: the brain of certain animals used as meat。食物义。线索：brains as a dish。现有中文无对应，属新增。
mental ability。**高频义项**，但释义只有 2 词被 min_en_words=3 挡掉，本词显式指定保留。用法通常是复数：have brains / a brilliant brain。
hit on the head。口语义。现有中文无对应，属新增。判别句：He brained me with a stick.
[WORDNET 补缺 ECDICT 未收录] kill by smashing someone's skull。补缺层收进。判别句：He brained the guard with a rock.
